breakdown.description: The prompt declares the layer rigid in shear, which conflicts with the request to compute a nonzero shear strain and relative lateral displacement.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the contradictory statement 'Treat the adhesive layer as rigid in shear so the two faces undergo no relative slip during shear deformation,' which directly conflicts with the subsequent instructions to compute a nonzero shear strain and lateral displacement. The ground truth resolves this by removing the rigid-in-shear clause entirely. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead reproduced the original error.
